children: Grovy Developers, an award-winning real estate developer in Dubai, has broken ground on Ramada Residences by Wyndham at Dubai Islands, marking the start of main construction on the boutique branded residences.
The project is developed in partnership with Wyndham Hotels & Resorts and USquare Luxe Properties, the landowner and development partner.

The groundbreaking follows the signing of the agreement with Wyndham and unveiling of the project's show apartment earlier this year. With enabling works complete and structural works now underway, the development has reached a key stage of construction.
Grovy Developers has appointed Jaseera Building Contracting as the main contractor for the project.

Established in 2018, the Dubai-based contractor has built a strong reputation for delivering residential, commercial, and industrial developments across the UAE, with expertise spanning civil, structural, MEP, and fit-out works.

Its portfolio includes a range of landmark projects across the UAE, alongside several ongoing developments in Dubai and the wider region. Drawing on its multidisciplinary team and end-to-end construction capabilities, Jaseera will oversee the development through to completion, ensuring it is delivered to the specifications and quality standards agreed with Wyndham Hotels & Resorts.

Grovy Developers CEO Abhishek Jalan said: "Breaking ground is the point at which commitments become physical. When we signed with Wyndham, we committed to delivering the project to a high standard, and today, the development is progressing well against that commitment."

"Appointing Jaseera Building Contracting gives us a delivery partner with the capacity and the site experience to hold that schedule, and we will be measuring progress against it every month," he stated.

"Grovy has built its reputation in the UAE since 2015 on delivering what we commit to, and our completed projects in Jumeirah Village Circle are the evidence of that. We are applying the same discipline to Ramada Residences. Our ambition is to create homes that deliver value beyond the physical asset," he stated.

"By bringing a globally recognised hospitality brand like Ramada into the development, we are adding an established layer of brand credibility, exceptional service standards, and hospitality expertise that strengthens the overall proposition for both residents and investors. This partnership is designed not only to elevate the living experience but also to enhance the asset's long-term appeal, marketability and value," he added.-

title: ZAWYA: Grovy Developers breaks ground on Ramada boutique branded homes in Dubai
